This means FAO1952 is NOT a source that reports on the full AOI aggregate under the "Ethiopia" label — for this source, "Ethiopia" 1936-1941 rows should generally reroute to ETH-1907-1952 rather than AOI-1936-1941, unless a specific row shows the ~70% magnitude inflation the wiki's contradictions section flags as the AOI signature. Worth revisiting the fao1952-sourced alias rule that routes "Ethiopia" 1936-1941 to AOI-1936-1941, as it appears too broad for this particular source.
